_about: Site-wide editorial configuration. Phase boundaries and the pipeline policy are decisions for the site owner; change them here, not in templates.

kumbh.name: Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh Mela
kumbh._forcePhase: Set to one of preparation, mela_open, peak, extended, post_kumbh, evergreen to pin the whole site to a phase regardless of the date (useful for previews). null means follow the calendar.

phases.label: Preparation
phases.basis: Before the reported flag-hoisting on 31 Oct 2026.

phases.label: Mela open
phases.basis: Mela reported to open with dhwajarohan on 31 Oct 2026; peak bathing dates have not begun.

phases.label: Peak Kumbh period
phases.basis: Editorial planning window of roughly two weeks before the first and two weeks after the last reported Amrit Snan date (2 Aug – 12 Sep 2027). Move it when the Authority confirms dates.

phases.label: Mela continues
phases.basis: The Mela is reported to conclude with the flag coming down on 24 Jul 2028.

phases.label: After the Kumbh
phases.basis: Live Kumbh items archive; evergreen and historical Kumbh guides stay.

phases.label: Nashik, year round
phases.basis: Kumbh is one topic among many; the homepage leads with Nashik itself.

pipeline._note: autoPublishLowRisk ships OFF. Even when on, high-risk items (tools/nt/risk.py) always need a named human approver.

freshness._note: How long a verified fact or page may go without a re-check before the content-health report flags it stale.

contact.formEndpoint: contact form is handled by the existing Formspree integration on /contact/

analytics._note: GA4 (existing measurement ID) is on the home, discover, plan and destination pages and on every page added in this phase. sitewide=true makes apply-chrome add it to the remaining legacy guides too — a decision for the site owner, so it ships off.
